senses.gloss: Adri^1, son of Viśvagaśva, descendant of Ikshvāku. § 475 (Dhundhumārop.): III, 202, 13517.
Adrijā (“born from the mountain”), a river? § 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7648 (Kṛshṇavenā?).

Adrikā, an Apsaras, cursed by Brahmán to become a fish; when dwelling in the Yamunā river she drank the semen of Uparicara, was caught by a flsherman, and gave birth to Matsya and Satyavatī. § 76: I, 63, 2388--9.--§ 191 (Arjuna): 123, 4817 (with other Apsarases she sings and dances at the birth of Arjuna).
